sections.Kurzabstract: The ECR-G-10 is used for the self-assessment of experience and behaviour in partnership attachment in adulthood. The questionnaire is the short form of the Bochumer Bindungsfragebogen (BoBi), the German version of the Experiences in Close Relationships Scale (ECR). The two attachment dimensions avoidance and anxiety are measured with 10 items. Reliability: The internal consistency of the two scales proved acceptable to high in several samples (ω = .73-.84, α = .72-.81). Validity: The examination of factorial validity yielded a good model fit. The construct validity of the two scales was demonstrated by convergent and discriminant correlations, in line with expectations, with scales on partnership, personality and mental health.
sections.Diagnostische Zielsetzung: The ECR-G-10 is used for the self-assessment of experience and behaviour in partnership attachment in adulthood. The questionnaire is based on the two-dimensional model of attachment, which distinguishes between avoidance and anxiety in the relationship with the partner.
sections.Aufbau: The instrument consists of 10 items, 5 for assessing avoidance and 5 for assessing anxiety. Responses are given on seven-point Likert scales.
sections.Grundlagen und Konstruktion: The ECR-G-10 is the short form of the Bochumer Bindungsfragebogen (BoBi), which in turn is the German version of the Experiences in Close Relationships Scale (ECR).
sections.Empirische Prüfung und Gütekriterien:
Reliability: The internal consistency of both scales proved acceptable to high in several samples (ω = .73-.84, α = .72-.81).
Validity: The examination of factorial validity yielded a good model fit. The construct validity of the two scales could be demonstrated by convergent and discriminant correlations, in line with expectations, with scales on partnership, personality and mental health.
Nomen: The instrument is not normed.
sections.Testkonzept/Theoretischer Hintergrund: The questionnaire "Experiences in Close Relationships Scale - German 10-Item Short Form" (ECR-G-10; Neumann, Rohmann & Sattel, 2023) is used for the self-assessment of attachment to the partner in adulthood. The instrument is based on the two-dimensional model of attachment, which distinguishes between avoidance and anxiety in partnership attachment (Brennan, Clark & Shaver, 1998). Avoidance stands for discomfort in situations of closeness and an emphasis on autonomy in the relationship. Anxiety stands for excessive preoccupation with the relationship, up to the worry that it might break up, and a strong desire for attention and affection from the partner.
sections.Testkonzept/Testaufbau: The ECR-G-10 consists of 10 items, with 5 items each serving to assess avoidance and anxiety. Responses are given on seven-point Likert scales with the endpoints "stimmt überhaupt nicht" (1) to "stimmt voll und ganz" (7).
sections.Testkonzept/Auswertungsmodus: For scoring, the values of items 1, 3, 7, 9 are reversed/reverse-keyed. The odd-numbered items (1, 3, 5, 7, 9) form the avoidance scale, the even-numbered items (2, 4, 6, 8, 10) the anxiety scale. Scale scores are formed by computing the mean of the respective items. For scoring, at least four items per scale should have been answered.
sections.Testkonzept/Auswertungshilfen: Because the raw item scores are simply averaged to a scale mean for each scale, no scoring aids are needed.
sections.Testkonzept/Auswertungszeit: Manual scoring takes approx. 3 minutes per case. With statistical programs such as SPSS and R, scoring of entire data sets can be carried out with a syntax.
sections.Durchführung/Testformen: The ECR-G-10 is the short form of the Bochumer Bindungsfragebogen (BoBi) by Neumann, Rohmann and Bierhoff (2007, 2012; see also https://www.testarchiv.eu/de/test/9005701), which in turn is the German version of the Experiences in Close Relationships Scale (ECR) by Brennan, Clark & Shaver (1998).
sections.Durchführung/Altersbereiche: The instrument is suitable for adults of any age.
sections.Durchführung/Durchführungszeit: Answering the ECR-G-10 takes approx. 3-5 minutes.
sections.Durchführung/Material: Besides the documentation of the procedure and the questionnaire, a writing implement is needed if the ECR-G-10 is used as a paper-pencil test. Electronic testing is also possible. This requires appropriate equipment (hardware and software).
sections.Durchführung/Instruktion:
The following instruction precedes the questionnaire:
„Im Folgenden finden Sie eine Reihe von Aussagen über das Erleben und Verhalten in Liebesbeziehungen. Bitte schätzen Sie für jede Aussage ein, inwieweit diese auf Sie zutrifft. Hierfür steht Ihnen eine Skala von 1 (stimmt überhaupt nicht) bis 7 (stimmt voll und ganz) zur Verfügung. Markieren Sie bitte jeweils die Zahl, die den Grad Ihrer Zustimmung wiedergibt. Wenn Sie zurzeit keinen Partner/keine Partnerin haben, versuchen Sie, sich an Ihre letzte Beziehung zu erinnern.“
sections.Durchführung/Durchführungsvoraussetzunge: The participants should have a good command of the German language and should not have a moderate to severe intellectual disability. The questionnaire can also be presented to persons who currently do not have a partner; however, they should have had at least one longer relationship.
sections.Testkonstruktion: The items of the ECR-G-10 were selected from the 36 items of the Bochumer Bindungsfragebogen (BoBi). Item selection and its test-statistical examination were carried out in the study by Neuman, Rohmann and Sattel (2023) on four samples with a total of 1747 participants. Stepwise confirmatory factor analyses (SCOFA) of the 18 items of each of the two scales showed that a 5-item solution is optimal for both scales of the short version. Model fit was examined with an Ant Colony Optimization (ACO) following the approach of Schroeders, Wilhelm and Olaru (2016). Internal consistency was examined as a measure of reliability. Furthermore, the correlations of the two new short scales with the long scales of the BoBi were computed. To examine the independence of the two new scales, their intercorrelation was determined. These three criteria, supplemented by model fit, were used to determine the best possible combination of five items. A two-factor confirmatory factor analysis served to examine the factorial structure. Finally, the two scales of the ECR-G-10 were correlated with scales on partnership, personality and mental health as external criteria.
sections.Gütekriterien/Objektivität: Owing to a standardized instruction and the precise specifications for forming the scale scores, objectivity in administration and scoring is given. Interpretation objectivity is also given, as the scores are always interpreted in the same way. Low, medium and high scale scores each stand for corresponding levels of avoidance and anxiety.
sections.Gütekriterien/Reliabilität: For both scales of the ECR-G-10, internal consistency was computed according to McDonald and Cronbach. Acceptable to high internal consistency was found. McDonald's omega (ω) was between ω = .78 and ω = .84 for avoidance and between ω = .73 and ω = .77 for anxiety; Cronbach's alpha (α) was between α = .75 and α = .81 for avoidance and between α = .72 and α = .76 for anxiety.
sections.Gütekriterien/Validität:
Owing to the wording of the 10 items, which is oriented towards assumptions of attachment theory, the ECR-G-10 can be credited with face validity. This initial assessment was confirmed by the statistical examination of validity.
The ACOs led to a solution with a good model fit in all four samples (Comparative Fit Index (CFI): avoidance .99, .99, .99, .97, anxiety: .99, .99, .99, .98, Root Mean Square Error of Estimation (RMSEA): avoidance .02., .01, .05, .09, anxiety .04, .05, .07, .06). The two new short scales correlated highly with their respective corresponding long scale, with loadings between .89 and .93, and showed low correlations with the respective other long scale. The two-factor structure was confirmed in the factor analysis. The 10 items loaded highly on the factor to which they were assigned, with loadings between .40 and .94. The loadings on the respective other factor were low and often close to 0.
The intercorrelation (r) of the two short scales was low in all samples (between r = -.03 and r = .14) and was always below the threshold for a small effect.
Construct validity was shown in the correlations with the external criteria. Avoidance showed significant negative correlations with satisfaction and erotic attraction in the relationship and with the personality traits extraversion and conscientiousness, as well as a positive correlation with depression. Anxiety correlated positively with strongly emotionalized, possessive behaviour in the relationship, with the personality trait neuroticism, and with depression and anxiousness. The associations of the two scales with other content-related scales demonstrate the convergent validity of the ECR-G-10. That the two scales moreover show different patterns of correlations demonstrates discriminant validity.
sections.Gütekriterien/Normierung:
No norm values are available.
As with the long form (BoBi), differences depending on age and mental health were also found for the short form (ECR-G-10) (see Table 1). For avoidance, low values were found in younger, clinically unremarkable students and high values in middle-aged patients with a diagnosed mental disorder - in most cases a depressive or somatoform disorder. Comparable differences did not occur for anxiety.
Table 1
Means of avoidance and anxiety in three selected samples
Age | Avoidance | Anxiety
N | M (SD) | M (SD) | M (SD)
Student sample1 | 277 | 23.71 (3.99) | 1.91 (.89) | 3.83 (1.20)
General population sample2 | 110 | 38.48 (14.74) | 2.60 (1.07) | 3.39 (1.25)
Clinical sample1 | 462 | 43.59 (12.51) | 3.13 (1.33) | 3.53 (1.43)
Notes. 1Neumann, Rohmann & Sattel, 2023, 2Makuch & Neumann, 2016.
Gender effects play a minor role. Cohen's d in the comparisons of the means of women and men on the two scales was between .00 and .03, i.e. the effect sizes were small or close to 0.
sections.Anwendungsmöglichkeiten: The ECR-G-10 is suitable for use in (attachment) research in various samples (general population, student and clinical samples). Furthermore, the instrument can be used in clinical practice for individual diagnostics.
sections.Bewertung:
The ECR-G-10 enables an economical and valid assessment of partnership attachment in adulthood. The instrument is suitable for adults of all age groups and for clinically unremarkable as well as mentally ill participants.
Because the assessment is based on self-report, unconscious processes in the relationship may be captured only inadequately. Here one should think in particular of the tendency to idealize the relationship, which is sometimes reflected in the response behaviour of participants who appear rather attachment-avoidant from an external perspective. A tendency towards social desirability also cannot be ruled out.

Hierfür steht Ihnen eine Skala von 1 (stimmt überhaupt nicht) bis 7 (stimmt voll und ganz) zur Verfügung. Markieren Sie bitte jeweils die Zahl, die den Grad Ihrer Zustimmung wiedergibt. Wenn Sie zurzeit keinen Partner/keine Partnerin haben, versuchen Sie, sich an Ihre letzte Beziehung zu erinnern.

ECRG1001.Description: Ich rede mit meinem Partner/meiner Partnerin über fast alles.

ECRG1002.Description: Manchmal merke ich, dass ich meinen Partner/meine Partnerin dränge, mehr Gefühl und Verbindlichkeit zu zeigen.

ECRG1003.Description: Ich wende mich oft an meinen Partner/meine Partnerin, zum Beispiel wenn ich Trost und Bestätigung brauche.

ECRG1004.Description: Ich mache mir sehr oft Gedanken darüber, dass ich meinen Partner/meine Partnerin verlieren könnte.

ECRG1005.Description: Ich fühle mich unwohl, wenn mein Partner/meine Partnerin mir sehr nahe sein will.

ECRG1006.Description: Wenn ich es nicht schaffe, das Interesse meines Partners/meiner Partnerin auf mich zu ziehen, rege ich mich auf oder werde ärgerlich.

ECRG1007.Description: Ich bespreche meine Sorgen und Probleme meistens mit meinem Partner/meiner Partnerin.

ECRG1008.Description: Es frustriert mich, wenn mein Partner/meine Partnerin nicht so oft bei mir ist, wie ich es will.

ECRG1009.Description: Ich fühle mich wohl dabei, wenn ich meine innersten Gedanken und Gefühle mit meinem Partner/meiner Partnerin teilen kann.

ECRG1010.Description: Ich brauche die Bestätigung, dass mein Partner/meine Partnerin mich liebt.
